LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: HANDWRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing: Paragraph Writing (2 sessions) • Reordering jumbled 
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing: Handwriting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Handwriting. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it good to write clearly?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify features of good Arabic handwriting for information
2. create a well-written story using the Arabic writing style

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: HANDWRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Handwriting for Grade 9 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify features of good Arabic handwriting for information
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. create a well-written story using the Arabic writing style
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Handwriting using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Handwriting above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Handwriting to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Handwriting.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Handwriting with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Handwriting important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it good to write clearly?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify features of good Arabic handwriting for information
2. create a well-written story using the Arabic writing style

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
